method: Read the installed reference's DEX in a disposable output directory. No changes to reference APK.

findings.map_editor: LocalMapActivity saves drawing data in onSaveInstanceState. There is no evidence this hook saves the text fields of the object dialog.
findings.attachments: AttachmentsActivity opens the Android document picker and has Open and Remove from object actions. The observed background is #232D1D. The project-approved QA style uses the blue palette and Arimo.
findings.playback: MediaPlaybackActivity builds a local preview with a Back button. Its observed reference background is #232D1D.
findings.limits: Static observations do not establish running layout or behavior parity. Text attachment preview is an agreed requirement of the independent app.
